title: Top Student
prompt: A class summary needs the student with the highest average score. Write a function that returns that student's name. If there are no students, return an empty string.

explanation.beginner:
Example: topStudent([{"name":"Ada","scores":[90,95]},{"name":"Grace","scores":[100,70]}]) produces "Ada". The result must follow this precise rule: A class summary needs the student with the highest average score. Write a function that returns that student's name. If there are no students, return an empty string. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns empty for no students”: input [[]] produces "". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
